title: screen/1: suspect screening of an aligned feature table by mass and formula
description: The text of screen.suspects@1 (crates/mzlab-feat/src/flow_screen_suspects). Each hit is a feature, an adduct and a formula with the listed structures that share it (an isomer group, never one name). A candidate is a mass and formula coincidence with the evidence found (RT difference, listed fragments found in the MS2), never an identification: level 5 = mass and formula only, 4 = the formula is also a candidate of formulas/1. The match key is the InChIKey first block (skeleton); a name or a formula alone never makes a match. Native flow run and the browser (attributio .wasm) write the same bytes.

polarity.description: of the table; only its adducts are searched

adducts.description: the adducts searched, after the filter by polarity

suspect_files.description: the provenance of every list used, in the order of the port; a candidate names its files by index

skipped_rows.description: CSV rows without a usable mass or formula

provenance.description: the manifest of a .mzsus; null for a CSV of the user

ms2_scans.description: MS2 scans read from the spectra; null when the port is not wired

dropped_groups.description: formula groups left out by max_hits_per_feature (the farthest in mass go first)

hits.description: sorted by feature, adduct, delta_ppm, formula

feature.description: id of the row of the table (1-based)

delta_ppm.description: (observed - theoretical) / theoretical of the closest candidate

formula.description: neutral formula (Hill); empty for a CSV row that gives only a mass: such a row is a group of its own

candidates.description: every listed structure with this formula that falls in the window, sorted by skeleton

skeleton.description: InChIKey first block, the match key; empty for a CSV row without a key

inchikey.description: the full key when the list gives it, else the first block

rt_diff_min.description: feature RT - listed RT; null when the list has no RT

fragment_mz.description: the listed fragments found in the MS2 of the feature, within ppm

files.description: indexes into suspect_files of the lists that name this structure

memberships.description: the lists of a regulatory package that name the structure; [] for a list without the listings extension
